area_identificacao.titulo: Annaes da Escola de Minas de Ouro Preto

area_conteudo_estrutura.ambito_e_conteudo: Letter from Henrique Gorceix discussing financial constraints preventing publication of memoirs requiring engravings, selecting works without engraving, expressing hope for favorable reception of the second number of the Annaes da Escola de Minas de Ouro Preto, and referencing his situation in Ouro Preto.
